title: Petra and the Protocol
author: Mara Coldharbour
blurb: Rosalind Thornbury, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
